note: One cycle, no loop needed. EC-SYS-003 (Log Before Act) is now enforced for real via a Claude Code PreToolUse hook on Write|Edit, not just documented. Scope is deliberately narrow: Bash calls are not gated (stated limitation, see 01-plan.jsonl). This hook is not installed/active for the current session (the pmcro plugin isn't loaded here) — it activates for any Claude Code session that installs the pmcro plugin.
